assets.title: Turn rough notes into a draft
assets.content:
Subject: Turn rough notes into a draft
Preview text: Give your ideas a starting shape with Typefully’s writing tools.

Give your rough notes a first shape

Hi there,

Rough notes are enough to begin. Start a new Typefully draft and add the fragments, points, or half-formed sentences you want to develop.

Typefully is a focused social-post writing workspace. Once your notes are in the draft, its AI writing tools can expand or rewrite them, giving you another way to shape the first version.

If the substance is already there, you don’t need a different topic. You need a place to start turning it into a post.

The first draft doesn’t need to be perfect. It just needs to begin.

Create your first draft → https://typefully.com/

- Typefully

reader_verdicts.what_it_sells: Typefully offers a social-post writing workspace where I can paste my rough notes into a draft and use AI tools to expand or rewrite them, helping me turn fragments into a first post this week.
reader_verdicts.relevance_feedback: The profile explicitly says I have a new Typefully account and rough notes for a social post, so the email’s premise—“Give your rough notes a first shape”—directly matches my current situation. The email additionally suggests that I want AI help expanding or rewriting those notes; whether I prefer that assistance is unknown, but it is presented as optional.
assumed_experiences: Profile-supported: I have a new Typefully account.
Profile-supported: I have rough notes for a social post.
Email-only: I may want to develop fragments or half-formed sentences into a post using AI writing tools.
Email-only: The substance of my intended post may already be present in my notes.
reader_verdicts.problem_now: Turning my established rough notes into a social-post draft is relevant now, although the profile gives no deadline or urgency. Trying this in one draft sounds like a small, appropriate next step.
reader_verdicts.biggest_doubt: I cannot yet picture the quality or degree of control I would get from “expand or rewrite”; I would want to know whether it preserves my point and voice. That doubt would not stop me from trying it once because I already have the account and suitable notes.
reader_verdicts.to_click_it_would_have_to: I would have clicked if this email had told me I could put my existing fragments into a new draft and use Typefully’s AI tools to expand or rewrite them—which it does.
fixes: Rewrite “Once your notes are in the draft, its AI writing tools can expand or rewrite them” to clarify, using verified details, what I select or click and whether the tool works on particular notes or the whole draft.

Replace “If the substance is already there, you don’t need a different topic. You need a place to start turning it into a post.” with a brief, concrete before-and-after example of rough notes becoming a draft, if an accurate example is available.
